blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former President Rodrigo Duterte appeared before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III in The Hague on Tuesday for the fourth status conference in his crimes against humanity case. Today’s attendance marked Duterte’s second personal appearance in the court proceedings./ dp READ: Rodrigo Duterte expected to appear in 4th ICC status conference...
